# vMLX 1.6.62

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.61 updater manifest (`a7f857ec0`)
- fix(cache): refresh native SSD boundary indexes after pool mutations (`746bf5f6e`)
- perf(qwen4): add opt-in precise AR sigmoid epilogue (`4b270967d`)
- fix(stream): preserve explicit MLLM cancellation terminals (`3f9ed1e43`)
- fix(chat): display server-side cancellation notices (`d790ea7c7`)
- fix(tools): bound exceptional MCP results in display and continuation (`0a4e54e4f`)
- Preserve explicit cancellation across Chat and Messages (`b1fc48ce7`)
- Preserve returned errors on templated Ollama generate (`9bc9b576b`)
- Preserve typed rejections in raw Ollama generation (`189576df1`)
- Refresh completed durability records in busy health snapshots (`a906ce8c2`)
- fix(chat): settle streaming state after navigation (`9b67785bd`)
- fix(ollama): preserve raw completion usage and measured duration (`13a102300`)
- fix(cache): publish new block fence pins atomically and recover failed writes (`dde29882f`)
- fix(chat): surface model preflight progress and start failures (`289d2d04f`)
- perf: add bounded opt-in cold-page hints for Qwen PLE (`a039ae1b0`)
- Add opt-in exact Qwen AR down and HC boundary fusions (`483088133`)
- Add opt-in mixed-dtype Qwen GDN prework fusion (`81946bb9b`)
- Add opt-in deferred packed PLE for productive Qwen AR (`abc12ce49`)
- Remove deferred PLE scheduling after matched serving regression (`99ca9c411`)
- Enable guarded Qwen AR fusions with explicit opt-outs (`6e245498b`)
- Add guarded GLM compound mHC normalization for AR decode (`59d482ded`)
- Admit hydrated GLM coefficients and expose compound graph counts (`22f958c97`)
- Add guarded GLM router and shared projection dispatch (`7d87c536b`)
- Enable qualified GLM AR compound normalization with explicit opt-out (`0b123b172`)
- Prepare 1.6.62 qualified AR and continuation fixes (`1e4198255`)
- Add Bonsai2 Hadamard and packed ternary runtime with guarded loading (`7537d458b`)
- Document Bonsai2 runtime in upcoming 1.6.62 release (`b32b2edea`)
